setup.name: frontend-inputs
argv: const fs=require('node:fs');for(const n of ['package.json','package-lock.json','tsconfig.json'])if(!fs.existsSync(n))throw Error('Missing required frontend manifest: '+n);const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));for(const n of ['typecheck','lint','test','build'])if(!p.scripts?.[n])throw Error('Missing required frontend script: '+n);if(/passWithNoTests|if-present/.test(JSON.stringify(p.scripts)))throw Error('Successful test skips forbidden');const ts=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('tsconfig.json','utf8'));if(ts.compilerOptions?.strict!==true)throw Error('TypeScript strict checking required in tsconfig.json');const files=fs.readdirSync('.',{recursive:true}).filter(n=>!n.startsWith('node_modules/')&&!n.startsWith('dist/'));if(!files.some(n=>/\.(test|spec)\.[jt]sx?$/.test(n)))throw Error('Missing required frontend tests');

checks.name: frontend-versions
argv: const p=require('./package.json');if(require('react/package.json').version!=='19.3.0')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: react required 19.3.0');if(require('react-dom/package.json').version!=='19.3.0')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: react-dom required 19.3.0');if(require('vite/package.json').version!=='8.3.4')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: vite required 8.3.4');if(require('typescript/package.json').version!=='7.0.2')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: typescript required 7.0.2');if(require('@vitejs/plugin-react/package.json').version!=='6.1.2')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: @vitejs/plugin-react required 6.1.2');if(require('eslint/package.json').version!=='10.12.0')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: eslint required 10.12.0');if(require('vitest/package.json').version!=='5.0.3')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: vitest required 5.0.3');if(require('@testing-library/react/package.json').version!=='16.3.3')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: @testing-library/react required 16.3.3');if(require('@types/react/package.json').version!=='19.3.0')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: @types/react required 19.3.0');if(require('@types/react-dom/package.json').version!=='19.3.0')throw Error('Frontend version incompatible: @types/react-dom required 19.3.0');for(const [n,t] of Object.entries({typecheck:'tsc',lint:'eslint',test:'vitest',build:'vite'}))if(!p.scripts[n].includes(t))throw Error('Required frontend script tool missing: '+n);
